title.description: The recurring meeting's title (operations: create, update)

frequency.description:
The recurrence frequency. Possible values:

- *daily*
- *working_days*
- *weekly*
- *monthly_day_of_month*
- *monthly_nth_weekday* — enum: daily|working_days|weekly|monthly_day_of_month|monthly_nth_weekday (operations: create, update)

interval.description: The interval between occurrences. Not applicable for working_days frequency. — integer >= 1 (numeric string ok) (operations: create, update)

monthlyDay.description:
Day of month for `monthly_day_of_month` frequency.
Required for `monthly_day_of_month` unless inferred from `startTime`. — integer >= 1 (numeric string ok) (operations: create, update)

monthlyOrdinal.description:
Ordinal position for `monthly_nth_weekday` frequency.
Required for `monthly_nth_weekday` unless inferred from `startTime`.
Allowed values:
- `1` (first)
- `2` (second)
- `3` (third)
- `4` (fourth)
- `-1` (last) — integer (numeric string ok); enum: 1|2|3|4|-1 (operations: create, update)

monthlyWeekday.description:
Weekday for `monthly_nth_weekday` frequency.
Required for `monthly_nth_weekday` unless inferred from `startTime`. — enum: sunday|monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday (operations: create, update)

endAfter.description:
How the recurrence ends. Possible values:

- *specific_date*
- *iterations*
- *never* — enum: specific_date|iterations|never (operations: create, update)

endDate.description: The date on which the recurrence ends. Required when endAfter is `specific_date`. (operations: create, update)

iterations.description:
The number of occurrences after which the recurrence ends.
Required when endAfter is `iterations`. — integer >= 1 (numeric string ok) (operations: create, update)

startTime.description: The scheduled start time of the recurring meeting. (operations: create, update)

duration.description: The meeting duration in hours. (operations: create, update)

notify.description: Whether to send email notifications to participants. (operations: create, update)

id.description: Recurring meeting identifier — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: delete, get, update, list_occurrences_cancelled, list_occurrences_open, list_occurrences_past, list_occurrences_upcoming, cancel_occurrence, init_occurrence)

limit.description: Maximum number of occurrences to return. Defaults to 20. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list_occurrences_upcoming)

start_time.description: The ISO 8601 start time of the occurrence to cancel (e.g. `2025-06-02T10:00:00Z`) (operations: cancel_occurrence, init_occurrence)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
